articles.summary: 文章报道，特朗普在白宫记者会上威胁对在海外建设数据中心的美国科技公司施加“巨额惩罚”，但没有说明具体措施，并称尚未告知政府官员。记者会还涉及伊朗“脏弹”情报、他与普京和习近平的关系，以及为副总统万斯把共和党中期选举失利归因于伊朗战争的说法辩护。读者可借此了解美国科技与数据中心政策可能面临的政治不确定性。

articles.sourceExcerpt: President gives wide-ranging White House press conference and says he has ‘fantastic relationships’ with Putin and Xi Donald Trump threatened on Friday to impose “tremendous penalties” on American tech companies that build datacenters outside the US, though he gave no details and told reporters he had not yet informed his own officials about the plan. In a discursive press conference from the White House briefing room, Trump also said he would “look into” the report that Iran had been planning to possibly detonate a “dirty bomb” in Washington DC, and backed JD Vance over comments the vice-president made blaming Republican midterm losses on the Iran war.

articles.title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading
articles.highlight: Anthropic创纪录的IPO未能阻止全球AI相关公司抛售，纳斯达克本周市值蒸发约4万亿美元。
articles.summary: 报道显示，Anthropic上市第二天股价下跌，叠加AI相关公司遭抛售，纳斯达克综合指数抹去2026年全部涨幅，并较1月1日下跌5%；道指和标普500进入回调区间。报道还称纳斯达克本周市值蒸发约4万亿美元，投资者质疑投入AI建设的巨额资金能否得到回报。这有助于理解AI概念股回调如何从个股扩散到更广泛市场。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键要点：AI相关股票的集中抛售可迅速传导至大盘，即使有明星IPO也难以托住市场；投资者正在重新审视AI基础设施投入的回报。
articles.sourceExcerpt: The Nasdaq lost trillions in value, with the AI startup’s IPO failing to buoy it as investors question huge sums being poured into AI buildout Who are Anthropic’s seven co-founders, now worth $180bn? As Anthropic’s stock dropped during its second day of trading, the wider stock market dipped with it. On Friday, the Nasdaq Composite erased all its gains for 2026 and closed down 5% from its value on 1 January.

en.highlight: Anthropic’s record-breaking IPO failed to stem a global sell-off in AI-linked companies, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq erased some $4tn in market value this week.
en.summary: The report says Anthropic’s stock fell on its second trading day, and a broader sell-off in AI-linked companies pushed the Nasdaq Composite to erase all of its 2026 gains and close 5% below its 1 January value. The Dow and S&P 500 closed in correction territory, while the Nasdaq shed about $4tn in market value this week as investors questioned the huge sums being poured into AI buildout. It is worth reading for a view of how AI-related market stress can spread from a single IPO to the wider market.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that a concentrated sell-off in AI-related stocks can quickly spill over into the broader market, and even a high-profile IPO may not stabilize sentiment while investors reassess returns on AI infrastructure spending.

articles.sourceExcerpt: 1 Stabilizing Neural-to-Image Retrieval with Frequency-Domain Priors and Adaptive Supervision YaoYang Liu, ZhuoShi Tang, Haopeng Lai, Weijun Sun*, Xiaozhao Fang*, Jie Wen, Fellow, IEEE Abstract—Visual neural decoding aims to infer perceived visual stimuli from brain activity, offering important insights into human visual cognition while enabling transformative applica- tions in brain computer interfaces and artificial intelligence. Recent advances in pretrained vision-language models have provided a semantically rich representation space for this task. However, reliable alignment between EEG/MEG signals and visual embeddings remains challenging because neural responses are noisy, highly variable across trials, and subject dependent.

articles.title: The War Against Slop and an Emerging Weapon to Fight it: Formal Verification
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: 文章讨论形式化验证：用数学方法证明软件符合规格，过去依赖专家手工完成。随着 AI 与 Lean 结合，证明过程正被部分自动化，这可能改变软件质量的保障方式。对非技术管理者而言，它提供了一个判断高风险软件是否值得投入更高验证成本的视角。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键要点是：形式化验证的价值在于把正确性变成可检查的证明，但引入 AI 自动化并不自动等于零成本或零风险。管理者应关注适用场景、工具成熟度和团队能力，而不是把它当作万能质量保证。
articles.highlight: 用数学证明软件正确，传统上需要专家投入；如今 AI 与 Lean 正在帮助自动化这一过程。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Proving software correct with math has traditionally required specialist work. Now AI and Lean are helping automate the process.

en.highlight: Proving software correct with math traditionally required specialist work; now AI and Lean are helping automate the process.
en.summary: The article discusses formal verification: using mathematical methods to prove software meets its specifications, a task that historically depended on specialists. With AI and Lean, parts of the proof process are being automated, potentially changing how software quality is assured. For non-technical leaders, it offers a lens for judging when high-risk software justifies the higher cost of stronger verification.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that formal verification turns correctness into checkable proofs, but AI automation does not automatically make it free or risk-free. Leaders should examine the use cases, tool maturity, and team capabilities rather than treating it as a universal quality guarantee.
en.title: The War Against Slop and Formal Verification as an Emerging Weapon
